body_text: Very disappointing experience. I ordered Chicken Chilly from Prathamesh Rolls, but the delivery status kept showing "10 minutes away" for over 30 minutes. Due to the unnecessary delay, I cancelled the order, yet Swiggy charged the full ₹159 as a cancellation fee. It's unfair to make customers pay the entire amount when the delay is on the platform's side. Swiggy should have a fair cancellation policy for delayed orders.
